scope: Separate non-oracle research comparator only; not CredBlock-FL architecture
attribution: All distinct exact observed IP strings used by an actual locally alerted User in (t-600 seconds,t], any authentication outcome. No minimum failure count, attacker-IP list, campaign membership, ranking or learned policy. If no recent evidence, no indicator.
duplicates: At most one live indicator per issuing organization and exact IP. Repeated local alerts while live are suppressed and do not extend expiry. At expiry a new actual local alert may issue a new episode. Identical duplicate deliveries are idempotent; conflicting payloads reject.
lifetime: [issued_at,issued_at+600 seconds); available_at equals issued_at. Expire before processing events at exact expiry. No manual revocation/correction oracle; false indicators expire normally.
timestamp_barrier: At t expire due records; all organizations with a local command at t update/score independently; derive indicators from those original local alerts; sort and broadcast to all other organizations at t; then apply received indicators to authentication evidence at t. Organization iteration order must not change outcomes. No cascade: indicator-assisted alerts never issue indicators.
recipient_rule: On the unchanged local scoring rows, local_plus = local_alert OR a current authentication at t by that same local User with an IP matching a received live indicator. No rescore or modification of previous decisions; no retrospective matching of older authentication records on receipt. Heartbeat rows without current authentication can only be local alerts.
additional_event_users: Record indicator matches for current authentication Users not scored by the accepted local policy separately with local_status=NOT_SCORED. Do not silently count them as local no-alerts or include them in paired scored-row comparisons.
private_provenance: Source alert references, local User IDs, recent observations, model scores and graph state remain solely in organization-local private stores. Public payload contains no alert/User identifier, campaign identity, raw record or feature.
selection: Single transparent policy fixed before any new comparison outcomes; no hyperparameter sweep or use of TEST. Ten-minute evidence and TTL align to the accepted recency clock, not a tuned optimum.
evidence: Fresh actual full-hour local inference in each org must exactly reproduce the accepted local-only score/alert digest and graph. Global sharing replay then interleaves those immutable causal local journals with zero simulated delay; repeat in reverse organization order. No indicator feedback changes local model, graph or targets.
evaluation: Paired operational User-score decisions on the same accepted rows, separate additional event-only decisions; no ground-truth join, FPR/recall/TTD claim or primary fixed-grid amendment. 1% fixed-grid calibration is not an operational event-driven guarantee.
future: No final TEST evaluation, detectability-boundary classification, federation, DP, robust aggregation or Fabric
